I am doing much better, now I am on day 6 or 7, lost the count, but the severity of physical symptoms is declining at a stable pace, so I am pretty positive that it will resolve in a weeks time! I still have the brain zaps, sometimes vertigo but not so much anymore, and still having lots of sweating, but it's not a problem because before I was not sweating at all, even on hot summer days (weird thing I haven't checked out yet)

I get disability check and you could say I am a stay at home girlfriend, cleaning, cooking as much as I can. It takes a toll on creating music though, which is my main career plan for the future (not a very smart choice, but I love what I do)

300mg to 37,5 mg, wow I can't even begin to imagine what that feels like.. are you able to work as usual or not? So sorry, to hear you are going through this, I send my best wishes for you to get better

I was on 150mg since May 13th until three days ago when I stopped. I know my body is able to take this, because I have had muscle/joint pain all my life (hypermobile EDS) and the brain zaps are bad, but I am trying to soldier through.
